default String asCql​(boolean includeFrozen,

        Description copied from interface: DataType
        Builds an appropriate representation for use in a CQL query.
        Specified by:
        asCql in interface DataType
        Parameters:
        includeFrozen - whether to include the frozen<...> keyword if applicable. This will need to be set depending on where the result is used: for example, CREATE TABLE statements use the frozen keyword, whereas it should never appear in CREATE FUNCTION.
        pretty - whether to pretty-print UDT names (as described in CqlIdentifier.asCql(boolean).
